scripts.title: Aimbot and Glow Update v22
scripts.features:
🔥 AIM ASSIST UI v22 — by DrNeusence
A sleek, high-performance aim assist script for Roblox. Built with modern graphics, smooth animations, and an intuitive interface.

🎮 Features
✨ Aimbot
Hold RMB to lock onto the nearest enemy inside the FOV circle.

Smooth camera tracking with dynamic lerp for natural aiming.

Auto‑switch to the next visible enemy when your target dies.

Visible & team check – only targets enemies you can see and are on opposing teams.

Customisable hitbox (head, torso, root) via settings.

FOV circle glows and changes colour when a target is locked.

✨ Glow ESP
Toggleable outlines on enemies (red) and yourself (blue).

Highlights work through walls and automatically update when characters spawn.

✨ UI
Dark glassmorphic design with gradient title bar and pulsing border.

Draggable – move the window anywhere.

Typewriter tooltips – hover over buttons for animated descriptions.

Insert key toggles the entire UI (hide/show).

Fully optimised, no memory leaks.

🧪 How to Use
Insert – show/hide the menu.

AIMBOT button – turns the aimbot on/off (green = on, red = off).

GLOW button – toggles enemy/self outlines.

Hold RMB (right mouse button) while the aimbot is on to lock onto enemies inside the FOV circle. Release to unlock.

📜 Credits
Created by DrNeusence.
Inspired by the desire for a clean, efficient, and visually appealing aim assist tool. Enjoy!
